name: Smart Recruitment System
overview: Smart Recruitment is a backend system for managing recruitment workflows including candidate processing, CV handling, and interview scheduling.
contribution: Built a microservices-based backend using Node.js and Express with separate services for authentication, candidate management, filtering, and interview scheduling. Implemented gRPC communication between services and integrated OpenAI API for CV analysis. Added JWT authentication to secure API endpoints and ensure controlled access across services. Improved automation of candidate screening and reduced manual processing by introducing structured API-based recruitment workflows and AI-assisted CV evaluation.

name: CodeCraft
overview: CodeCraft is a backend-focused coding practice platform for executing programming tasks and tracking user progress.
contribution: Developed backend logic for task management, submissions, and progress tracking using Node.js and TypeScript. Integrated Supabase for authentication and data storage and used Piston API for code execution. Implemented role-based access control and protected admin functionality. Added feedback system with SendGrid notifications. Enabled structured coding practice with automated code execution, user progress tracking, and secure role-based access for administrators and users.

name: AquaTrack
overview: AquaTrack is a full-stack application for tracking daily water intake with user goals and progress analytics.
contribution: Worked as team lead coordinating backend and frontend integration. Built REST APIs for user data, hydration tracking, and authentication flows. Designed API documentation using Swagger and implemented email verification, password reset, and Google OAuth authentication. Managed GitHub workflow including pull requests and code reviews. Ensured consistent data flow between frontend and backend and delivered a stable full-stack system with working authentication and real-time tracking features.

name: Attaboy Dog Training
overview: Attaboy Dog Training is a web platform for managing client communication and business operations for a real dog training service.
contribution: Built admin system for managing testimonials and client inquiries. Implemented authentication-based workflows, contact forms with email notifications, and admin dashboard for content management. Deployed application and set up CI/CD pipeline using Vercel.Provided a working business platform that supports client communication and simplifies content and inquiry management for daily operations.

name: GardenShop
overview: GardenShop is a responsive e-commerce web application for browsing and showcasing garden plants, with product catalog, cart functionality, and contact features.
contribution: Built a full frontend application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Implemented dynamic product catalog using JSON data, including search and filter functionality. Developed interactive UI components such as product cards, image carousel, and modal views for product details. Added shopping cart functionality using Local Storage with real-time updates. Built a validated contact form and ensured responsive design across devices.
